verse: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
story: Jesus walks along the Sea of Galilee and speaks to two fishermen who are busy at their nets.

He does not offer them a seminar. He says come, follow Me, and promises to make them fishers of men. Simon and Andrew know boats and nets, and Jesus takes that ordinary skill and gives it a new purpose. The call comes first, and the making comes after. They drop their nets at once. The kingdom He announced has arrived, and He calls ordinary people to follow Him in it.
You do not have to be ready. Follow Him in the work in front of you today, and let Him do the shaping.
